items.text: Ladd McConkey (rib) will not practice Wednesday; status up in the air for Week 2 vs Raiders. ETR lists Tre Harris as primary beneficiary.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; Harbaugh/ reports confirm no Wed practice, day-to-day previously.
items.implication: Questionable/possible OUT; reduce start % until Thursday/Friday practice.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Quentin Johnston and depth WRs if out.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, an indication he could return on Sunday.
items.why: Full participant after ankle injury; Rapoport notes indication of Sunday return.
items.implication: Potential RB upgrade/return for NE backfield; monitor for active status.
items.opportunity: Could reclaim carries if cleared; handcuff value rises if limited.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury kept him out of Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Week 2 availability in doubt; monitor Thursday/Friday reports.
items.opportunity: Potential snap increase for other DEN RBs if sidelined.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday but got mental reps and expects to play Sunday vs Texans.
items.why: Back tightness caused DNP; player and reports indicate he expects to play.
items.implication: Likely active; CIN passing game (Chase/Higgins) remains viable if he goes.
items.opportunity: No major role change expected if plays; monitor for limitations.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja'Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games to quicken recovery.
items.why: Wrist surgery; IR for at least 4 games.
items.implication: Season-long absence short-term; Ravens WR depth thins with Flowers also banged up.
items.opportunity: More targets for Bateman/other Ravens WRs; ETR notes Bateman/Moore beneficiaries.

items.text: A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain; expected out 4-6 weeks. ETR lists Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas as waiver beneficiaries.
items.why: Confirmed high-ankle sprain post-MRI; multi-week absence.
items.implication: Sit/IR stash; NE WR depth gets opportunity.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/targets for Doubs and other Pats WRs.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Wednesday, remains day-to-day after Week 1 aggravation; status uncertain for Week 2 vs Saints. Not considered serious initially.
items.why: Hamstring tweak in Week 1; no Wed practice, coach day-to-day.
items.implication: Risky start; possible OUT or limited. Lamar/BAL passing game impacted if out.
items.opportunity: Bateman and depth WRs see more targets if Flowers sits.

items.text: Matthew Berry highlights Deebo Samuel as a top Week 2 waiver wire target on FFHH after MNF/Week 1 production and Stribling injury fallout.
items.why: Strong Week 1 usage + teammate injury creates clear opportunity; top add on show.
items.implication: Add immediately in most leagues; WR flex/WR3 upside.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers: De’Zhaun Stribling OUT (ankle surgery ~10 weeks) makes Deebo Samuel (and Demarcus Robinson) primary beneficiaries/adds. Also McConkey=Tre Harris, Lane=Bateman, Kamara=Miller, AJ Brown=Doubs.
items.why: Stribling IR/surgery opens SF WR snaps/routes; Deebo already producing.
items.implication: Priority waiver add; elevated role in SF offense.
items.opportunity: Increased target/route share with Stribling out long-term.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3, but same knee had PCL sprain + bone bruise last year—scary history. DNP Wed but hopes for Thu/Fri.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery timeline short; coach hopes for practice this week; history raises caution.
items.implication: Stash/hold; possible TE1 if returns healthy, but risk of setback.
items.opportunity: If out, Michael Mayer full TE snaps; reverse if Bowers unexpectedly active.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominant early-down + receiving role as expected post-trade; elite opportunity share.
items.implication: RB1 lock ROS; every-down back in high-powered offense.
items.opportunity: Massive snap/route/target/carry share; handcuff Emmett Johnson elevated.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but simply played a horrific game. Bounce-back candidate on opportunity.
items.why: High xFP (targets/location/depth model) despite poor actual production; volume was there.
items.implication: Hold/start with confidence in DET offense; regression to mean expected.
items.opportunity: Strong route/target share opportunity persists; buy-low if available.

items.text: Travis Hunter played only 4 specialized offensive snaps in Week 1 (jet, screens, decoy); did not run a route past LOS. Jags' offseason actions (Meyers extension, not trading BTJ) signaled limited offensive role.
items.why: Extremely limited package; no traditional routes; intent clear from team moves.
items.implication: Low fantasy floor/ceiling early; more DB value than WR currently.
items.opportunity: Minimal route share; Parker Washington/others hold more WR opportunity.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate usage even with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 (Etienne/Miller/Donaldson), routes 24/5/7, opportunities 18/9/4. Committee persists.
items.why: Split work despite starter absence; not the clear lead expected.
items.implication: ETN more RB2 than RB1; Miller viable handcuff/flex in committee.
items.opportunity: Kendre Miller elevated role/snaps when Kamara out; monitor Kamara return.
